restaurant_name: คลินิกโรคปอดหมอรติ@ภูเก็ต
text: Do NOT come here if you’re a foreigner. I came here at 7pm, they made me wait for an hour, and let other Thai patients through before me even though I was there first, they made sure I was the last patient and everybody was gone. I came here because I had a really bad cough and had a slight chest pain, did an X-ray and doctor said I had bronchitis and will prescribe me some anti-biotic and some meds, upon check out I was presented with a 4500thb bill, which is absolutely ridiculous, the bill had no details, just a number, so I requested for a proper detail bill, and still it just shows medical fees + medicine 4500. And they would not explain why it’s so expensive, the doctor says his medicine are different to other clinics (however I’m sure you can get in any pharmacy). Absolute rip off, I’ve been to other clinics and got similar meds for only 600thb! If you don’t want to be ripped off don’t come here!
